verdict.rationale: Replit documents routines that turn a recurring job into a scheduled run that reports back to the user (replit-docs-49). It also documents background tasks where Agent works independently in isolated copies of the project, with results reviewed and applied later (replit-docs-39, replit-docs-48). Together these cover autonomous, background automation, but missing for 10: detail on routine configuration (triggers beyond schedules, run limits, failure handling, notifications), depth beyond one-line doc mentions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
